spec.question: Does a fixed calibration-text coexact field transfer to evaluation prefixes without future-token access?

split_policy.exact_id_and_normalized_text_overlap: forbidden across all corpus rows and with other historical suites for new rows
split_policy.near_overlap: report maximum historical word-trigram Jaccard before model work; no response-based replacement
split_policy.scope: Same authored families; unique scenario labels and strings do not establish stylistic independence or pretraining holdout.
split_policy.knowledge: Outcomes of the 40 calibration texts are known. All 40 are retained. Pilot/evaluation texts are first-authored for this protocol, before model responses.

geometry.pca_fit_scope: concatenated L7 token states from calibration texts only
geometry.graph_scope: one graph per calibration trajectory, all in the same fixed PCA chart; pool their nodes after decomposition
geometry.lookup: one nearest calibration node, Euclidean chart distance; first frozen node wins ties
geometry.delta_scale: median of the 40 per-prompt median raw-hidden centered-step norms; calibration only
geometry.null: isotropic Gaussian in the frozen PCA span, keyed by seed and frozen node index; hidden-space unit norm
geometry.normalization_boundary: PCA backprojection defines a candidate intervention direction, not an exact inverse of hidden-state L2 normalization.

evaluation.baseline: unhooked batch-12 with exactly the same prefix IDs as treatment
evaluation.target_access: only the scorer reads input_ids[prefix_length]; no target or suffix goes to hidden extraction, lookup, normalization, sign selection or RNG
evaluation.cache_policy: no mutable KV cache shared between prefixes or arms

runtime_gate.source_weight_bytes: all native-FP32 parameters must match before and after execution

future_invariance_gate.comparison: byte equality within a fixed runtime, seed, alpha and batch shape
future_invariance_gate.scope: Core NumPy tests are necessary but do not replace an integrated model-runner audit.

analysis.primary: signed odd coexact-minus-random next-token log-probability coefficient
analysis.aggregation: mean over 8 seeds, then mean over all 3 fixed prefixes, then equal-weight mean over 20 prompts
analysis.pass_rule: all 60 planned prompt/prefix cells valid and 95 percent lower prompt-bootstrap endpoint strictly positive
analysis.missing_policy: preflight every evaluation cell before nonzero treatment; any unsupported/zero/nonfinite direction yields INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE with the complete support table and no reduced-sample estimate
secondary: raw coexact and random signed responses versus baseline

stages: prepare text/token inventory without model weights

prompts.text: The library opened at nine in the morning. A student placed a notebook on the table, read three pages, copied two definitions, and walked home before the rain began.
The mechanic checked the battery, tightened the cable, measured the tire pressure, and wrote the repair number on a yellow form before closing the garage.
A nurse filled the water pitcher, adjusted the blanket, recorded the temperature, and reminded the patient to press the button if the pain returned.
The train arrived at platform four, paused for six minutes, and left the station after the conductor confirmed that every door was closed.
A teacher collected the quizzes, sorted them by row, marked the attendance sheet, and placed the answer key in the top drawer.
The city was a sleeping animal, its streets breathing under the lamps. By dawn, every window had become an eyelid, and the river remembered how to speak in silver.
The argument was a weather system. It gathered heat above the table, broke into rain behind his eyes, and left the room smelling of distant thunder.
Her memory was a lantern under water. Each name rose toward the glass, glowed for a moment, and drifted away before the hand could catch it.
The old computer dreamed in dust. Every keystroke woke a tiny moth of meaning, and the screen became a window that refused to stay square.
The garden kept a calendar in its roots. Spring signed in green ink, summer argued in bees, and autumn folded the answer into gold.
A mirror remembered being a door. It did not open, but every face that entered it came back carrying a different room, a different name, and the same quiet fear.
The statue insisted it was the sculptor. Its stone hands described the chisel, its mouth remembered the first mistake, and the museum listened without correcting it.
A letter woke believing it was the person who wrote it. It folded itself carefully, missed its own childhood, and waited for someone else to read its hands.
The mask forgot the actor and began answering to the applause. By midnight it had borrowed a pulse, a voice, and the burden of choosing.
A photograph denied being an image. It claimed the room around it was the copy, and every visitor left with a borrowed version of their face.
The map drank the road and called it home. A cup taught a child to forgive the ocean, while a shadow folded itself into a key and unlocked yesterday.
A calendar swallowed a bird and began migrating through Tuesday. The kitchen learned to orbit a spoon, and the floor politely forgot how to be below.
The question wore a coat made of answers. It poured itself into a staircase, climbed the listener, and arrived as a blue room with no walls.
A clock planted its hours in the garden. By evening, time had grown teeth, the roses became verbs, and the gate apologized for remembering everyone.
The road became a mouth and explained the suitcase to the moon. A number slept inside a candle, dreaming it was a horse made of rain.
At the bakery, the first batch of rolls cooled on a wire rack. The baker weighed the flour for tomorrow and cleaned the counter before locking the front entrance.
Two cargo containers stood beside the harbor crane. A dock worker compared their labels with the shipping list, then directed the forklift toward the empty storage bay.
The seedlings needed more space after a week in the greenhouse. Each plant was moved into a larger pot, watered gently, and labeled with its planting date.
Before the afternoon appointments, the receptionist checked the schedule and replaced the empty pen at the desk. A delivery arrived with fresh envelopes and a box of printer paper.
Three parcels were waiting in the mailroom when the courier arrived. She scanned each barcode, counted the signatures on the receipt, and loaded the parcels into her van.
Their negotiation was a narrow bridge assembled one plank at a time. Every concession extended it farther across the silence, until both sides could hear the footsteps approaching.
The rumor passed through the office like a loose thread. Each conversation pulled it a little farther, and by lunchtime an entire afternoon had unraveled around the knot.
Grief settled into the apartment as an early winter. Familiar routines grew brittle beneath it, although one unexpected laugh could still melt a path between the empty chairs.
The orchestra was a loom working in the dark. Violins stretched a fine pattern across the silence, while the drums secured its edges with a heavier thread.
His patience had become a reservoir after years of waiting. Small interruptions barely troubled its surface, but one careless promise opened a crack far below the conversation.
The violin claimed to be the composer, not the instrument. Its strings recalled writing the final movement, and it asked the musician to stop taking credit for its childhood.
A receipt insisted that it was the customer who had bought the groceries. It remembered choosing the apples and regarded the signature at its foot as a pair of shoes.
The uniform answered when the captain's name was called. It described voyages that the captain had never taken and accused the body inside it of impersonating the fabric.
The timetable refused to describe the journey because it believed it was the journey. Its columns complained of exhaustion, and its printed destinations asked where their passengers had gone.
A recipe announced that dinner was already served because it was the meal itself. The ingredients on the page tasted the reader and wondered why a person needed seasoning.
Silence hired a staircase to translate weight into hunger. Each landing collected a different appetite, and the basement paid its rent in distances that nobody had traveled.
A fraction married the distance between two bells. Their anniversary became a triangle of warm weather, which the accountant wore inside a sentence to keep the balance asleep.
The horizon purchased permission to become a paragraph. Its punctuation melted into glass, and the remaining landscape queued politely for a chance to be pronounced instead of seen.
An accent filled a bucket with departures and carried it through the ceiling. Upstairs, a kilogram of hesitation was learning to subtract the color from an unfinished promise.
Absence stepped onto the scale and weighed the grammar of the room. The result was a temperature with pockets, selling vowels to the furniture in exchange for somewhere else.
The gardener counted the seed packets, checked the dates on their labels, and arranged them in separate trays. Before leaving the shed, she wrote the planting schedule on a board beside the window.
The argument settled over the kitchen like fog. Each apology opened a narrow path through it, but the oldest accusation remained on the table, a damp coat that nobody wanted to carry outside.
The calendar insisted that it had once been a witness rather than a record. Whenever someone turned a page, it corrected their account of the trial and asked why its own name had been removed.
The recipe folded a thunderstorm into its sleeve and waited for the flour to confess. When the oven asked for evidence, a quiet Thursday stepped forward and offered to become the missing ingredient.

The clerk replaced the empty ticket roll, tested the printer, and counted the change in the drawer. When the first customer arrived, she checked the destination before entering the fare on the screen.

The technician attached a sensor to the balloon and checked its radio signal from the courtyard. After recording the wind direction, he released the cord and watched the small instrument rise above the roof.
The builder measured the bathroom wall twice and marked a straight line above the sink. She spread adhesive over a small section, pressed each tile into place, and wiped the excess from the joints.

The archivist removed the staples from the folder and placed the first sheet on the scanner. He checked that every line was visible, saved the image with its reference number, and returned the page to its sleeve.

The driver stacked the bread crates near the bakery entrance and compared their labels with the delivery list. Before loading the van, she separated the damaged crate and asked the baker to confirm the remaining order.

The rumor was a loose thread running through the office. By lunchtime, every conversation had pulled it farther, and the tidy account of what happened began to unravel across desks that had never shared a secret.

Her grief kept its own railway timetable. Some mornings arrived without warning, carrying whole years in crowded carriages, while other days passed through the empty station so quietly that she forgot to look up from her tea.
The plan looked solid until the questions began to fall on it like warm rain. By the end of the meeting, everyone was balancing on a smaller piece of ice and pretending the shore had moved closer.

His patience was the last coin in a country that no longer accepted money. He carried it carefully through each delay, hoping that somewhere a small kindness could still be bought without explaining how poor he had become.

The melody built a staircase through the crowded room. With every repeated phrase, she found another step beneath her feet, until the noise of the party sounded like traffic far below an open upstairs window.
The uniform claimed that the captain was merely the shape it wore during the day. At night it arranged his medals in a different order and described a voyage that he could not remember making.

The receipt denied being a record of the purchase and introduced itself as the customer. It demanded a chair at the counter, explained what it had intended to buy, and blamed the printed total on somebody else.

The portrait began signing the painter's letters before he had written them. When he objected, it pointed to the unfinished canvas and asked which of them had spent the afternoon patiently inventing the other's face.

The staircase registered itself as a tenant and requested a room on the ground floor. It said that carrying people upstairs had been a temporary occupation, and that its original profession was waiting beside the sea.

The echo arrived before the singer and asked the audience to disregard his performance. It claimed that the voice on the stage was only a delayed copy, while the real musician had always lived between the walls.

Distance bought a sheet of stamps and posted itself to the nearest horizon. The envelope grew shorter on the journey, until the address could step across it and greet the arrival without leaving its own handwriting.

Silence hung its laundry between two unfinished questions. A passing answer borrowed the sleeves, but the afternoon refused to fit inside them, so the washing line began to explain why the weather had forgotten its name.

Gravity asked for a receipt after returning the mountain. The cashier weighed the absence on a pair of scales, then wrapped the balance in paper and warned that the refund might fall upward before the week was over.

Permission rearranged the furniture inside a locked verb. Every chair became a possible action, but the table refused to happen, leaving the room to decide whether sitting down required a body or only a different tense.

Duration spilled a bowl of salt across the unfinished century. Each grain remembered a different ending, and the broom could collect them only by persuading the floor that yesterday had not yet chosen a place to stand.

novelty_audit.scope: Repository data JSONL suites only; overlap score is descriptive, not an admission threshold. Authored new strings, not a random or external sample; no claim about training exposure or novel syntax/style.
